title: Borussia Dortmund and Werder Bremen Face Off in Bundesliga Matchday 5
seoTitle: Dortmund vs Bremen: Bundesliga Leadership at Stake
subtitle: Decisive Match for Leadership with Schlotterbeck's Return to the Hosts' Offense
excerpt: On October 9, Borussia Dortmund hosts Werder Bremen at Signal Iduna Park for Bundesliga Matchday 5. BVB leads the table in a crucial clash.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On the evening of October 9, Borussia Dortmund hosts Werder Bremen at Signal Iduna Park, at 8:30 PM (German time). The clash marks the fifth matchday of the 2026/27 Bundesliga and brings together the league leaders with the team in eighth position.

Why the Duel is Highly Anticipated

BVB arrives with six consecutive victories in official matches, including triumphs in the Champions League and the DFB-Pokal, and leads the competition with a maximum of 12 points. Werder Bremen, on the other hand, seeks to stabilize an inconsistent start to the season and overcome defensive frailties that have already resulted in five goals conceded away from home.

Teams' Recent Form

Borussia Dortmund has won all of their first four league games, scoring five goals at home and keeping a clean sheet on their own turf. Defensively, the team has not conceded any goals as visitors so far. Werder Bremen, in turn, has accumulated seven points from four matches, with two home wins but only one point from two away games, where they have conceded five goals.

Predicted Lineups

Coach Niko Kovac confirms the return of Nico Schlotterbeck in defense, forming a trio with Waldemar Anton and Joane Gadou. In midfield, Felix Nmecha is expected to lead the sector, alongside Marcel Sabitzer, while Serhou Guirassy spearheads the attack. Goalkeeper Gregor Kobel completes the defensive line.

For Werder Bremen, coach Daniel Thioune maintains the formation with Karl Hein in goal, followed by Deman, Friedl, Pieper, and Arthur in defense. In midfield, Regeer, Chuki, and Reis are starters, while Marco Grüll, Eren Dinkci, and Niclas Füllkrug complete the attacking line.

Performance Expectations

Statistics from the last ten direct confrontations favor Borussia Dortmund, who have won seven times, drawn twice, and lost only one match. The accumulated goal difference in the first four games of the season (+7) indicates the hosts' offensive capability, while Werder Bremen's defensive vulnerability in away games could be decisive.

How to Watch the Game

The match will be broadcast live on Sky Sport Bundesliga 1 and Sky Sport Top Event in Germany, with streaming available on the WOW platform. In Brazil, the match can be watched on channels that have a Bundesliga broadcast agreement.

With information from OneFootball, SPORT1, Sport Bild.
